2608.27364.title: Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm
2608.27364.paper_summary: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.
2608.27364.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究大型企業的後勤員工在生成式人工智慧（genAI）使用上的複雜性如何變化。使用專有數據，我們觀察到2025年八個月內，來自15個功能領域的近4,000名後勤員工的713,564條員工提示及其相應的大型語言模型回應。我們記錄了三個主要發現。首先，高級員工展示出更複雜的genAI使用，這與領域專業知識補充genAI能力相一致。其次，複雜性在不同功能之間變化顯著，在戰略、數位創新和專案管理中最高，這三個群體都專注於全公司戰略計畫和組織變革。第三，我們觀察到隨著時間的推移，複雜性並沒有改善，也沒有在正式的AI訓練後持續改善，這表明複雜的使用方式可能難以改變。總體而言，我們的研究提供了複雜genAI使用的衡量標準和見解，管理者可以利用這些來改善結果，而研究者則可以在未來的研究中使用這些資料。
